_source:
A real 'ICT Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's own department) was shared with this project via Drive, as a standalone Term 1 document and a standalone Term 3 document, each carrying real calendar week-dates (e.g. 12/01/26 - 16/01/26). A teacher's name and two different department/organisation labels found in these documents' headers are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy. This is a genuine gap fill -- this app previously had no ICT Form 2 content at all (only Form 1 Term 2). Cites the real official 'ICT Syllabus 2024 Form 1-4'.

Three literal duplicate re-uploads of the Term 1 document were identified and skipped (identical file size), and two literal duplicate re-uploads of the Term 3 document were identified and skipped (identical file size).

Term 2 is a genuine, confirmed content gap, not fabricated: two independent Drive searches (by filename keyword and by folder listing) turned up no ICT Form 2 Term 2 document at all, only Term 1 and Term 3. The real Term 3 document's own revision recap (week 1: 'Reviewing compression/encryption, word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, publishing, email, instant messaging, business applications') confirms that real Term 2 content existed and covered digital communication and ICT-for-business topics (e-commerce, digital marketing, entrepreneurship) -- but the source document itself was never found in this Drive folder, so no Term 2 topic is invented here to fill that real gap.

Term 3 itself contributes no new numbered syllabus topic: its own Topic column names only 'Revision & Consolidation', 'Project Work' (an integrated project applying file-management, spreadsheet, publishing and email skills already covered), 'Presentation of Projects', and a further run of Revision blocks (terminology, weak-area remediation, practical-skills consolidation, digital citizenship and copyright ethics, ICT for entrepreneurship, safe file practices, final review) -- none of these carry their own new '2.x' topic/sub-topic code in the source, consistent with the exclusion approach used elsewhere in this app for pure revision and application blocks. No separate Term 3 topic is invented here either.

Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 File Compression
sub_topics.description: Discussing the need for file compression (saving space, faster transfer), using software (e.g. WinRAR, 7-Zip) to compress files and folders, and comparing original and compressed file sizes.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 File Encryption
sub_topics.description: Discussing the need for encryption (data security, privacy), using built-in OS tools or third-party tools to encrypt a file or folder, and discussing the ethical use of encryption.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Word Processing (Advanced)
sub_topics.description: Advanced word processing features (tables, images, headers/footers, page numbering), creating a formatted document, and using mail merge and styles for consistent formatting.

competencies.description: Manage data using advanced word processing features

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Spreadsheets
sub_topics.description: Spreadsheet basics (cells, rows, columns, sheets), basic formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT), creating a budget sheet, creating charts (bar, line, pie) from data, and using functions (IF, COUNTIF, SUMIF) to sort and filter data.

competencies.description: Manage data using spreadsheets, entering data and applying basic formulas
Manage data using spreadsheets, creating charts and applying functions

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Presentations
sub_topics.description: Discussing effective presentations (purpose, audience, design), creating a presentation with text, images, transitions and animations, inserting charts/tables/multimedia, using a slide master, and practising delivery (voice, eye contact, timing).

sub_topics.name: 2.2.4 Publishing
sub_topics.description: Discussing desktop publishing (DTP) and its uses (flyers, brochures, posters), using DTP software (MS Publisher, Canva, LibreOffice Draw) to design a poster, and designing a multi-page publication (brochure or newsletter) using columns, text boxes and graphics.
